view.en: Fixed-screen 2D bullet-hell; the play area fills the whole frame. You control a twin-type shooter (type A homing shots / type B needle shots) and a tiny hit-point dot shows while moving slowly; the boss moves in the upper part; lives, bombs and power are overlaid at the corners, with the boss's health bar and card name at the top.

goal.en: Defeat every attack phase of the boss to win; you lose when all lives are spent. Each phase has a timer and a timeout only moves on to the next phase; lives do not regenerate.

mouse.en: The mouse does not steer; LMB is the same as fire and RMB the same as the screen-clearing bomb

keys.en: Slow movement; shows the hit-point dot and pulls the options in
Screen-clearing bomb; pressing it right after being hit cancels the death

notes.en: Only the tiny hit-point dot is hurt by bullets; grazing is harmless. Slow movement is precise, fast movement is for big repositioning.
Hold fire continuously. Type A shots home in on the boss; type B needle shots go straight ahead, so line up with the boss.
Bombs are limited: type A releases homing orbs and type B cross-shaped bars. A bomb grants invulnerability and clears bullets, and pressing it just after being hit cancels the loss of a life.
During spell cards shots do much less damage, so sustained fire is needed; bombs do comparatively more against cards.
After being hit you respawn at the bottom with brief invulnerability and bullets are cleared for a while.
There is a short pause between phases, with the boss returning to the centre and no bullets.
The easy tier gives more lives (5) and has fewer phases; the hard tier has denser cards.

options.bomb_hold: last-chance bomb held for the whole packet

summary.en: Stage-two boss that sprays showers of crystal shards and freezes them in place before releasing them again.

tell.en: Columns of shards fall from both sides and curve into arcs

effect.en: Arcing bullets cover both sides, leaving a big gap in the middle; the normal tier adds yellow five-way aimed shots

counter.en: Stay near the middle and watch the yellow aimed shots

tell.en: Small rings of shards fly out, slow to a stop, then each group leaves in turn on a downward arc

effect.en: Stopped rings act as obstacles and then leave as downward arcs

counter.en: Do not hug stopped rings; move to a gap before they set off

tell.en: Colourful bullets spray in random directions, then all stop and turn white

effect.en: Several rounds of blue multi-way aimed shots follow, then each white bullet slowly accelerates off in a random direction

counter.en: Find open ground while bullets are stopped, sidestep the aimed shots, and keep clear of white bullets before they scatter

tell.en: The boss keeps jumping around while bursts of shards pop out around her

effect.en: She changes position every moment and bursts several shards near herself

counter.en: Keep your distance and re-judge your position after every reposition

phases.en: Non-spell 1, Side Arcs (easy/normal) or Hanging Shard Rings (hard), Non-spell 2, Stall and Scatter, Drifting Shard Bursts (normal and above). The easy tier only has Non-spell 1 and Stall and Scatter.

summary.en: Stage-three boss who barely moves, firing two counter-rotating streams of bullets that weave into a net.

tell.en: Streams of many colours fire continuously from fixed angles

effect.en: The streams keep fixed directions, leaving lane-like gaps between them

counter.en: Stand in a lane and fine-tune your position with slow moves

tell.en: Bullets alternate between sparse and dense while drifting slowly

effect.en: A scatter that spreads outward; the dense stretches leave almost no gap

counter.en: Take position when sparse; hold still or bomb when dense

tell.en: Shards come in from both sides, accelerating as they travel

effect.en: They get faster over time, blocking both sides

counter.en: Stay near the middle and avoid the corners

tell.en: Radial bursts alternate with curving streams

effect.en: Radial parts have clear gaps between spokes; curving parts bend toward you

counter.en: Slip between the spokes during bursts and strafe during curves

tell.en: Two spiral streams rotate in opposite directions and cross each other

effect.en: The crossing points are the densest, and both streams keep rotating

counter.en: Move with the rotation and avoid the crossing points

phases.en: Non-spell 1, Fixed Angle Streams, Non-spell 2, Drifting Scatter (hard), Non-spell 3, Side Accel Shards (easy/normal) or Burst and Curve (hard), Crossing Spirals (normal and above). The easy tier only has Non-spell 1 and Side Accel Shards.

summary.en: Stage-four boss with rotating beams; each beam also emits element-themed bullet patterns.

tell.en: Fiery bullets fall while swaying side to side

effect.en: Bullets rain from above and the sway makes landing spots hard to read

counter.en: Move side to side with the sway; do not stand still

tell.en: The same wavering fall but with more, denser bullets

effect.en: Narrower gaps

counter.en: Make small slow corrections and bomb at the densest moment

tell.en: Yellow bullets fly out, stall, then turn and head in a new direction

effect.en: Stalled bullets are temporary obstacles and become a new pattern after turning

counter.en: Stand in open ground while they stall and predict the new direction

tell.en: Stall-and-turn bullets plus large heavy shots

effect.en: The large bullets shrink the room you can dodge in

counter.en: Dodge the large ones first, then read the gaps in the small ones

tell.en: All-direction rings alternate with stalled bullets that restart later

effect.en: Rings force you to move and stalled bullets set off when you think it is safe

counter.en: Do not stay beside stalled bullets; use the gaps between rings

tell.en: Two emitters fire curving streams in opposite directions

effect.en: The two curving streams cross each other

counter.en: Stay between the streams and move along the curve

tell.en: Green streams come diagonally from above, with scattered fire bullets

effect.en: The diagonal stream covers one side while fire bullets fall sparsely

counter.en: Stay on the open side and watch for the scattered bullets

phases.en: Non-spell 1 (rotating beams that also emit bullets), Wavering Fall, Non-spell 2, Stall and Turn or Stall Turn and Heavy Shots, Rings and Stalls, Twin Curving Streams, Corner Stream and Sparks. The easy tier only has Non-spell 1 and Rings and Stalls.

summary.en: Stage-six boss that weaves nets of beams and fires large shells that leave trails; in her last cards she turns into bats.

tell.en: Beams interweave into a net and bullets are released from it

effect.en: The net divides the field and bullets come out along it

counter.en: Stay off the beams and choose an open cell

tell.en: The beam net stays still while large shells are fired

effect.en: The net does not move and large shells keep coming

counter.en: Memorise the net first, then dodge the shells

tell.en: Thin bullets fall while crossing bullets cut diagonally

effect.en: Many thin bullets plus crossing bullets that block your route

counter.en: Sidestep the crossing bullets and use slow moves for the thin ones

tell.en: Thin bullets bounce off walls and blade-shaped bullets cross

effect.en: Bounces keep bullets in play for longer

counter.en: Keep away from the walls

tell.en: Blue blade bullets spiral out and leave red bullets behind

effect.en: Red bullets remain and accumulate

counter.en: Do not reuse the same route; reposition to avoid getting boxed in

tell.en: Even-numbered ways of large shells fly out leaving trail bullets

effect.en: An even way count leaves a gap straight ahead

counter.en: Stand between two ways

tell.en: Fast large shells aimed right at you

effect.en: Fast, with little reaction time

counter.en: Sidestep early and do not back up in a straight line

tell.en: A leading large shell comes with a ring of bullets in volleys

effect.en: The leader sets where the ring goes

counter.en: Track the leader and hide between rings

tell.en: Large shells bounce off walls leaving trails, and the boss turns into bats

effect.en: Trails accumulate; bombs work differently in this card

counter.en: Stay off walls and do not rely on bombs

tell.en: Large shells leave trails while a ring is added; the boss turns into bats

effect.en: Trails plus rings leave narrow gaps

counter.en: Find the ring gaps and avoid the trails

phases.en: Each tier has four non-spells and five cards; the easy tier only has Non-spell 1 and Bouncing Trail Shells. Cards come from the easy/normal set or the hard set.

summary.en: Stage-one boss who spreads her arms and sweeps rings and fans of bullets; plain bullet attacks alternate with spell cards.

tell.en: Light-blue and blue bullets alternate and sweep left and right like wings, aimed at you

effect.en: Each volley is a few fan-shaped wings sweeping a wide arc; she moves between volleys

counter.en: Slip through the gap between wings and stay off the aim line; the repositioning moment is safest

tell.en: Several waves of red and blue rings expand and rotate in opposite directions; after a pause a row of aimed bullets follows

effect.en: The rings expand slowly, then the aimed bullets grow in number

counter.en: Follow the gap between rings and sidestep when the aimed bullets come

phases.en: Non-spell 1, Alternating Sweep, Non-spell 2 (laser, yellow counter rings, aimed green rings), Counter Rings. The easy tier only has Non-spell 1, Alternating Sweep and Counter Rings.

summary.en: Stage-five boss who stops time and lays knives meanwhile, releasing them when time resumes; you, your shots and enemy bullets are frozen during a stop.

tell.en: Small bullets scatter, then the screen freezes while she crosses it laying knives

effect.en: Knives aimed at you and parabolic ones are laid; all move when time resumes

counter.en: Note the knives during the freeze and move to the side without knives

tell.en: Random bullets drift down, then time stops and she moves leaving knives on her way

effect.en: Knives aim at you and surround you

counter.en: Leave through a gap you noted as soon as time resumes

tell.en: Fixed all-direction bullets, then time stops and lines of knives appear between her and you, some turning green

effect.en: Knife lines fly toward you when time resumes, and green knives turn

counter.en: Take the gaps between lines and leave early for green knives

tell.en: A random knife curtain; the closer you are to her, the farther away knives appear

effect.en: During the stop knives are placed in a ring around you

counter.en: Stay moderately far from her for larger gaps

tell.en: Slow four-way blue and red knives that turn into scattered green knives after a time stop, some bouncing off side walls

effect.en: Green knives scatter in all directions after the stop

counter.en: Dodge the slow knives first, then read gaps in the green ones

tell.en: A ring of knives appears; blue ones slow to a halt, red ones stop and then aim, some turn green in the time stop

effect.en: Knives pause and then fly at you

counter.en: Stay away from resting knives and prepare to sidestep before red ones aim

phases.en: Non-spell 1, Stop and Lay Knives (easy/normal) or Trail Knives (hard), Non-spell 2 (four magic circles shooting walls of kunai, plus knife rings), Knife Lanes or Surround Knives, Non-spell 3, Turning Ricochet Knives or Rest and Aim Rings. The easy tier only has Non-spell 1 and Turning Ricochet Knives.
